brief.zh: 画出 a 和 b 「中间」的那个斑点：从 a 往 b 走了 t（0 是 a，1 是 b）。
brief.en: Draw the blob "between" a and b: t of the way from a to b (0 is a, 1 is b).

hint.zh: 两张图逐格按比例混合，得到的是两个淡斑点。<level-ref to="8-1"></level-ref>的两个数呢？
hint.en: Mixing the two pictures cell by cell gives two faint blobs. What about <level-ref to="8-1"></level-ref>'s two numbers?

after.zh: 像素空间里的中间是两张图叠在一起；潜空间里的中间才是「一个斑点在中间」。训练好的编码器把图放进一个平滑的空间，在里面走直线，解码出来就是一串自然的过渡：人脸变老、换发型都是这么做的。
after.en: Halfway in pixel space is two pictures laid over each other; halfway in latent space is "one blob in between". A trained encoder puts pictures into a smooth space, and walking a straight line there decodes into a natural transition: making a face older or changing a hairstyle works like this.

t.zh: 托盘里有训练好的编码器和解码器：编码器把一个斑点变成两个数，解码器把两个数画成斑点。
t.en: The tray holds the trained encoder and decoder: the encoder turns a blob into two numbers, and the decoder draws two numbers as a blob.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：画出从斑点 a 往斑点 b 走了 t 的那个斑点。
t.en: Your task in this level: draw the blob that is t of the way from blob a to blob b.
